rulesNote: never is never traded or dropped, hold is not traded until that day, keep is never suggested as a drop. Names as Yahoo shows them.

Onyeka Okongwu.note: whether his usage picks up as Atlanta's lead center, or a better center shows up on waivers

Neemias Queta.note: his minutes, he is a trade piece for a center like Naz Reid and becomes droppable only if his minutes are cut

Moussa Diabate.note: whether he passes Queta as Charlotte's lead center

tiersNote: Set by Vikas on Oct 24 2026. trade is trade only, never dropped unless out for the season or out more than 6 weeks with no IL spot. float is earning his spot, never dropped for a stream. drop goes for any clear upgrade. A player on no list counts as droppable. review gives the games after which a spot is checked again and what else to watch. Streams should favor players who also last.
